title: Obsolete Http Web Request Mgt. usage in public API (webhooks, OData)
summary: Http Web Request Mgt usage is removed from webhook and OData public APIs by replacing DotNet-based code with native HttpClient and HttpRequestMessage, while obsoleting old event signatures.
key_points: SendRequest in API Webhook Notification Send uses native HttpClient instead of DotNet Http Web Request Mgt
Behavior preserved: POST with JSON headers, UTF-8 body, timeouts, telemetry tags, and retry rules unchanged
ODataUtility CreateMetadataWebRequest method obsoleted; callers should use native HttpClient/HttpRequestMessage
